items.difficulty_reason: Given the pushout situation of two closed immersions plus maps f : X' -> X, g : Y' -> Y and an isomorphism phi of the pulled-back closed pieces over Z, the induced h : X' coproduct Y' -> X coproduct Y (pushouts glued along phi) satisfies: h is locally of finite type / flat / flat finitely presented / smooth / etale if and only if f and g are, each clause listed with the author's trailing add more here as needed placeholder retained; the clause dictionary is exactly the properties list of the chapter's pushout calculus. The retained proof is written: pushouts exist by the companion lemma (collected same wave as L16144) so h is defined; affinize everything (reduce to affine schemes over the pushout's affine decomposition); the five equivalences become the corresponding five assertions of the algebra pushout-fibre-product theorem More on Algebra, lemma properties-algebras-over-fibre-product (the patching-of-properties result for pullback squares of rings), quoted by the author as an equivalence transfer rather than reproved. Retained author proof at lines 20041-20050.
